page.content:
Undead incarnation of the Mushroom War's extinction wish.

How The Lich connects

  • Faction: Heroes of Ooo — The Lich is the extinction Finn and Jake have to stop.
  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — The Lich is the series' oldest extinction threat.
  • Event: Mushroom War — The Lich is born from the Mushroom War's bomb.
  • Location: Farmworld — Farmworld is a wish-timeline the Lich still infects.
  • Item: Enchiridion — The Lich wants the Enchiridion as a key.

What is The Lich?

The Lich is the skeletal enemy who wants all life gone, born from the bomb, wearing a well, a snail, and later a smiling Billy suit.

Key threads lead to Heroes of Ooo, Adventure Time (series), Mushroom War, Farmworld and Enchiridion.
